mechanism_queue_policy: Reuse representative samples tagged by actual observed path, summarize separately without multiplying daily load. R059/Optica/LWW/OCE not in this saved journal/service pool, unconfirmed unless a lawful supported sample is later added with an explicit supplement.
measurement_protocol: One actual normal-UI pair per sample; no simultaneous downloads/build/full tests/large collection. Correct permanent PDF+original association endpoint, actual poll bounds. Confirm file/DOI/title/version before deleting trial body. Separate first access, challenge, manual waiting and warm repeats; unknown timings remain missing. Preselected normal controls get two further exchanged-order pairs. Anomalies require investigation and two repeats with equivalent access, not replacement.
sequence_policy: Execute declared first-pair sequence in order where both sides have usable legal access; if a platform has an actual preparation/verification blocker, retain its entries and gap, continue independent prepared platforms, record deviations. No substitute sample after results.

post_fix_supplement.selection_basis: Existing ScienceDirect-mapped original Papers in the same two configured journals as the earlier recovered samples. post_fix_supplement.scope: Separate mechanism cohort. Initial frozen representative results remain included.
